title: Reading the payoff chart
summary: Expiry and pre-expiry payoff lines, breakevens, 1σ and 2σ bands, risk : reward and probability of profit.

questions.q: On a payoff chart, the breakevens are where the line:
questions.why: Breakevens are the stock prices where profit is exactly zero.

questions.q: The expiry payoff of a short strangle looks like:
questions.why: Flat at the full credit between the strikes, falling on both sides.

questions.q: Roughly how often should a stock finish inside its 1σ expected move?
On Theta Desk, the 'risk' in risk : reward means:
options: The expiry loss after a 2σ move against you
questions.why: A naked short has no fixed maximum, so a 2σ move is used as the realistic bad case.

questions.q: A trade shows 90% POP and a 2σ loss of 8× the premium. It is:
options: Still dangerous: read POP next to the risk
questions.why: High POP with a large tail loss can still lose money over time.
